shape: A five-file published npm library: index.js, index.d.ts, a test, a benchmark. No UI, no server, no database.
whyThisShape: The few-or-no-entrypoints case. There are no pages, no routes, no jobs and not enough files to cluster, so a prompt that assumes an application shape has nothing to fill its sections with. The interesting failure here is not a wrong claim but an INVENTED structure — a 'Traced Flows' or 'Architecture in Depth' section that manufactures subsystems out of one exported function. That is the same over-fitting the reviewer saw, in its most extreme form.
labeledFrom: Cloned and probed: 5 files in scope, zero routes/pages/jobs.
